class INA219_Simulator(BaseVirtualSensor):
    REG_WIDTH = 16

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.regs = {
            0x00: 0x399F,  # Configuration register
            0x01: 0x0000,  # Shunt voltage register
            0x02: 0x0000,  # Bus voltage register
            0x03: 0x0000,  # Power register
            0x04: 0x0000,  # Current register
            0x05: 0x0000   # Calibration register
        }

    def read_register(self, addr: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> int:
        if nbytes == 1:
            return (self.regs[addr] & 0xFF00) >> 8
        return self.regs[addr]

    def write_register(self, addr: int, data: int, nbytes: int = 2) -> None:
        if addr == 0x00 and nbytes == 1:  # Handle single byte write to CONFIGURATION register
            self.regs[addr] = (self.regs[addr] & 0x00FF) | (data << 8)
            if (data & 0x80) != 0:  # Check if RST bit is set
                self.regs[addr] &= 0x7FFF  # Clear RST bit after writing
        elif addr == 0x00 and nbytes == 2:  # Handle double byte write to CONFIGURATION register
            self.regs[addr] = data
            if (data & 0x8000) != 0:  # Check if RST bit is set
                self.regs[addr] &= 0x7FFF  # Clear RST bit after writing
        elif addr == 0x05 and nbytes == 1:  # Handle single byte write to CALIBRATION register
            self.regs[addr] = (self.regs[addr] & 0xFFFE) | (data & 0x01)  # Ensure FS0 bit remains 0
        elif addr == 0x05 and nbytes == 2:  # Handle double byte write to CALIBRATION register
            self.regs[addr] = (self.regs[addr] & 0xFFFE) | (data & 0x01)  # Ensure FS0 bit remains 0
        elif addr in (0x01, 0x02, 0x03, 0x04):  # RO fields and writes are ignored
            pass
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid register address: {addr}")
